notes.title: Overrun Patch #1
notes.content:
Patch #1 notes:Made changes to game difficulty and tweaked some values to make the game more fun.Balanced waves so more enemies spawn quicker.
Reduced health of harder enemies to make them more manageable to fight.
Slightly increased player movement speed.
Slightly decreased enemy movement and projectile speed.
Increased amount of coins you get from each wave.

Thank you,
Total Involve
